dog.description_text: Meet Rudy! He is currently in foster care and ready for adoption via our virtual process! Rudy, a nine-year-old male, is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQCV59dSnMJAT6KYKQfbtsM-AcHydUeHANnejvUgSunDq6U?e=U1XVvu His foster says "Rudy has truly blossomed since the start of his foster. He has built confidence, found routines, is quite silly, and enjoys all the pets and play time he can get!. Rudy is a curious and snuggly cat. He only needed one day to warm up to the new space and immediately wanted to explore, play, and get all the pets. Over the past week he has truly settled in and built routines. Rudy has been pretty consistent personality wise so far. He’s very curious and interested by surroundings, not scared around people or new spaces. I like how curious and brave he is and how content he seems when he’s pet on the head. Rudy is a gentle giant. He’s sweet and has little meows, and he enjoys just being in your presence and being pet . He is a great reading buddy. He loves a comfy blanket and curling up next to you, and being tucked in. He is a huge lover! The way he loves to snuggle is by climbing on your chest and holding his head to yours. It is the sweetest habit. He is a goofball and loves to play! Even when he is tired he plays from under the blankets." He loves being in people’s company and will come up to you and chat. He is neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
